analyst_view.overall: Getafe (15th, 12 pts, unbeaten at home this season) host Atlético Madrid (3rd, 28 pts) on Sunday night; Atlético lost to Bayern and Barcelona before the break but have won four straight away games, and Simeone has a strong record at Getafe. Gudelj is banned and Uche and Juanmi are out (in the numbers), but Bordalás confirmed centre-back Zaid Romero is fit and back in the squad, and he said the break was used to work on defensive solidity. Atlético miss Lookman (in the numbers) and Cuti Romero, Pubill is a serious doubt (in the numbers), and all their internationals, Julián Álvarez and Sørloth included, were back in training on Friday; Hjulmand worked in the gym. Atlético host Viking in the Champions League on Wednesday, and no referee had been named in the pages I read.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and take Lookman and Pubill off. Getafe's home games under Bordalás are slow and tight, and he says the break went on defensive solidity with Zaid Romero back; Atlético's internationals are all back training, so I trim less than yesterday, to about 2.16.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners and already count Getafe's high recent corner count (38 in six). Getafe play direct and win corners from long balls and crosses, while Atlético have less width without Lookman, which the numbers count; nothing points clearly either way, so 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, counting both teams' card form and past meetings, but the game is not flagged as a derby. It is a Madrid-area meeting against a Bordalás side built on duels and slowing the game, and these meetings tend to get heated; with no referee named, a mild lean up to about 5.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.6 shots, and recent form has already pushed both sides up (+13% Getafe, +8% Atlético). Getafe rely on long balls and stoppages, and Simeone usually manages a game like this away before a Champions League night; a small trim to about 24.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.4 shots on target. A slow, stop-start game against a Getafe side that worked on its defence over the break should mean few clear chances, while Lookman's absence is already counted; a slight trim to about 7.3.
